decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development is integral to the development of Key Site One in meeting the objectives to IMP 2.2 the regenration of Hounslow Town Centre. Whilt challenging the policy direvtives on density there is sufficient justificaton and mitigation to accept high density in meeting  the policy imperative of IMP 2.2. The development is part and parcel of the wider regeneration scheme that gives a framework for the massing and built form proposed. It proposes a substantial new addition to the need for affordable housing in Hounslow meeting the objective of H 2.1.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - Construction shall not proceed beyond foundations stage until revised elevational details and samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the building hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Arrangements to minimise dust nuisance during construction and to ensure that mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site shall be in accordance with the measures previously agreed by the Council for the construction phase of the Key Site One development and shall be fully implemented.
The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 7 - Before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied, revised details of the arrangements for the storing and collection of refuse or recycling materials and waste shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Before any part of the development is first occupied or used, a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and shall be completed.

Condition : 9 - 1.	Before any part of the development is first occupied or used, full details of both hard and soft landscape works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  Hard landscaping details shall include all means of enclosure.
Soft landscape works shall include a schedule of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate.

Condition : 10 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of 5 years? from the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use.

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with BS 5837 and with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.
description: Erection of 7, 8 and 9 storey block to provide 67 X 1 bed and 83 X 2 bed flats, for key workers. (Prince Regent Road West Car Park)
